lever.text: Heavy metal slot machine lever pulled down hard, ratcheting creak then a loud mechanical clunk

spin.text: Slot machine reels spinning fast, steady loopable mechanical clicking and ticking, no music

stop.text: Single heavy slot machine reel stopping, one solid mechanical thunk

coin.text: A few coins clinking out of a slot machine tray, small sad payout

jackpot.text: Casino slot machine jackpot: ringing bells, siren, flashing lights, a flood of coins pouring into a metal tray

wahwah.text: Sad trombone wah wah wah waaah, comedic failure sound
